tier_description: Personalized Multi-Step Planning — questions requiring the system to produce a semester-by-semester course plan tailored to a specific student's history, program requirements, and scheduling constraints

category_descriptions.A: Graduation Planning (10 questions) — map out remaining courses to finish degree requirements by a target semester
category_descriptions.B: Adding Minor/Concentration (10 questions) — plan how to incorporate a new minor or concentration without delaying graduation
category_descriptions.C: Recovery Planning (10 questions) — chart a path forward after academic setbacks (AW, failed courses, missed prereqs)
category_descriptions.D: Elective Optimization (10 questions) — select electives that best satisfy multiple goals (interest, requirements, load balance)
category_descriptions.E: Comparative Planning (10 questions) — compare two or more valid course plans and recommend the better option

schema.persona_id: Persona identifier (always present for T4 questions)
schema.persona_summary: One-line description of the student's situation
schema.variation: Specific sub-scenario variant within the category
schema.question: Natural-language planning request as a student would ask it
schema.what_makes_this_hard: Key difficulty — the constraint(s) that make naive planning fail
schema.needs_verification: List of facts an advisor must validate before the plan is final

quality_notes: All 50 questions require multi-step planning across multiple semesters or requirements
All 5 categories have exactly 10 questions each
All 50 questions are persona-grounded using 47 distinct personas
Covers all 4 majors: CS (12), IS (13), BA (11), Biological Sciences (14)
3 questions involve students on Academic Warning requiring AW-aware planning
Draft answers require advisor validation before use
what_makes_this_hard field identifies the specific constraint that would trip up a naive system
